stop_rules: No modification of frozen RC6 paper, submission, provenance, spatial generator or NAAMP analysis paths.
Do not use global GloBI, GBIF, EarthEnv, NWI, ERA5 or JRC rows as a same-pond stage-specific predation measurement.
No source-blind response reuse: NAAMP post-hoc interspecific H1 exploration is not prospective confirmation.
No published mechanism language when measured hydroperiod, stage/predation exposure and event-level detection are absent.
A same-year egg predation event cannot causally explain an earlier adult chorus from that cohort.
Primary NPS green→wood directional acoustic suppression H1A not supported; do not post-hoc retune taxon, lag or window to obtain negative coefficients.
Carroll source metadata alone is not an acquired workbook or a verified adult-to-larval repeated-measures panel.
Immediate RC6 stand-alone submission is on editorial hold per dated author decision; never claim the candidate is withdrawn or already submitted.
Use verified exact pond-level matched ecology for Part II, not merely a paper citation or 1-km co-occurrence. Stand-alone RC6 retained as fallback only after explicit future editorial decision.
INBO G1 site-block gain fails independent future-year transport (M0 Brier 0.27839 vs M1 0.34786 in 2024–25); do not claim general predictive superiority.
INBO 245 matched Hyla records have no usable permanent-water-column measurement or numeric larval effort at the focal event; do not call their M0 hydroperiod adjusted.
Global 1-degree stage/time co-reporting cannot establish live same-pond predator-prey encounters; 16/18 general shifted-month gain is not a predation-specific effect.
Expanded predator-fixed matched alternative prey strict pattern 26/56 and median focal-minus-alternative -0.0185 must remain visible; do not cherry-pick exploratory positive mean.
